description: List the open Spark Signal Center queue: operational signals and proposed actions that still need attention. Open means recorded, proposed, approved, or failed (never executed/dismissed/expired). Filters are optional and AND-combined: eventType (exact signal discriminator), state, proposalsOnly, and createdFrom. Newest first; paged with Total + limit/offset (default 100, max 500). Returns compact summaries and linked proposed-action metadata (channel "sms" marks a proposal drafted by text in Text with Sparki); call get_action_context with an eventId for the safe evidence packet. A client-pinned credential sees strictly its own client's events; an operator credential sees the tenant's house and client-owned events. Read-only: this tool never changes inbox state.

createdFrom.description: Only events created on/after this UTC instant.

eventType.description: Optional exact payload.eventType filter, e.g. reorder_alert or backorder_alert.

proposalsOnly.description: When true, exclude recorded alerts and return only proposed/approved/failed work.

state.description: Optional open lifecycle state: recorded, proposed, approved, or failed.

name: list_open_actions
title: List Open Actions
